profile.headline: Senior Web Designer @ Brightstar Lottery | AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
profile.summary:
Senior Web Developer at Brightstar Lottery with over 10 years of experience in IT and data center operations. Contributed to systems support, security, and infrastructure management while leveraging skills in data center architecture, Linux, and Jira. Actively supports the development and maintenance of the Rhode Island Lottery website and mobile app.  

Focused on leveraging strong problem-solving and collaboration skills to enhance system reliability, minimize downtime, and improve security. As an AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, brings expertise in cloud platforms to deliver efficient and scalable solutions that align with organizational goals.
